name: Skill Definition
description: Core brainstorming methodology document that defines the step-by-step process for turning ideas into designs through collaborative dialogue, including the hard gate, process flow, principles, and transition conditions.

name: Spec Review
description: Subagent prompt template for automated quality assurance of design specs, checking completeness, consistency, clarity, scope, and YAGNI before implementation planning begins.

name: Visual Companion Guide
description: Detailed usage documentation for the browser-based visual brainstorming companion, covering when to use it, session lifecycle, content fragment authoring, CSS classes, event format, and cleanup procedures.

name: Server
description: Node.js HTTP/WebSocket server that provides session management, file watching (auto-serves newest HTML screen), token-based authentication, browser automation, idle timeout, and cross-platform launcher support for the visual companion.

name: Browser Client
description: Client-side presentation layer and interaction logic — the HTML frame template with OS-aware CSS theming (frame-template.html) and the WebSocket-driven helper script (helper.js) handling connection management, reconnection, event capture, and selection tracking.

name: Operations
description: Shell scripts for server lifecycle management — start-server.sh handles CLI argument parsing, session directory creation, PID tracking, cross-platform compatibility (Windows/Codex/Gemini), and background daemonization; stop-server.sh handles graceful shutdown, stale PID detection, and ephemeral session cleanup.
